greeting.title: Greeting / acknowledgement
greeting.text: Hi {{name}}! 👋 Thanks for reaching out. I'm looking into this now and will get back to you shortly.

order_status_checking.title: Checking order status
order_status_checking.text: Thanks {{name}}! I'm checking the status of order *{{order_id}}* and will update you in a few minutes.

refund_policy.title: Refund policy
refund_policy.text: Hi {{name}}, refunds are available within 30 days of purchase. To start one, please send us your order number and a short description of the issue.

need_more_info.title: Ask for more details
need_more_info.text: To help you faster, could you send a screenshot or describe the exact steps that led to the problem?

closing.title: Closing the conversation
closing.text: Glad we could help, {{name}}! If anything else comes up, just send us a message here. Have a great day! 😊
